description: How the chat shows a command or subagent the CLI runs in the background: its card keeps spinning, marked "running in background", and finishes in place when the task ends. A task whose card isn't in the chat (it started before what's drawn) gets one quiet line instead when it ends.
opens: A Bash call with run_in_background, or a subagent run asynchronously

parts.name: card while running
parts.shows: The call's card (ToolCall) keeps its spinner after its first result (which only says it started; that text is its first Output, "Command running in background with ID: …"), with "  · running in background" dimmed after the summary. The status bar and side panel's Processes / Subagents also list it (other areas).

parts.name: card when finished
parts.shows: The spinner stops; the "running in background" mark goes. A command's Output becomes the last 6,000 bytes of what it wrote ("… " before it when cut), in a code block tagged "output"; with no output file, the task's summary, tagged with its status. A subagent's final report is added to its output as markdown. Completed: normal border; failed or killed: red border and Error.

parts.name: ending line (no card)
parts.shows: One wrapping, selectable, left-aligned line, no icon: "What · — ". What: the card's tool name ("Bash") when the card is known, else "Agent" for a subagent or "Background command". Description: the task's description, else its command's first line, else what its summary quotes, cut at 80 characters with …, else "a background task". Ending: "finished", "failed", "stopped" (killed), with " (exit N)" when the summary gives an exit code. Dimmed when it finished; all in the error red when it failed or was killed. Never the raw command or the XML it arrives in. Tooltip: the task's full summary.

actions.by: click the description (when its card is drawn later, higher up)
actions.does: Scrolls back to the card, opening its group, and flashes it.

states.name: finished with card in chat
states.shows: No separate line: the card says it ended. The CLI then often starts a turn by itself to report it, drawn as a normal reply.

states.name: finished, card not drawn
states.shows: The ending line, in order in the chat.

states.name: never heard the end (finished session)
states.shows: Opening a chat whose transcript never says the task ended: its card shows interrupted, not spinning for ever.

states.name: Record
states.shows: Record's reader draws the same ending line (no link) for each task notification in a chat.
